import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])
coffee_sales['time'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['time'])

# Pivot data for easier plotting
coffee_sales_pivot = coffee_sales.pivot_table(index='date', values='total', aggfunc='sum')

# Create a line plot of total sales over time
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.lineplot(data=coffee_sales_pivot)
plt.title('Total Sales Over Time')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.grid(True)
plt.legend(title='Total Sales ($)')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
